mapper.sql: r.id, r.name, r.report_date, r.checkup_id, r.note, r.actor_user_id, r.request_id, r.request_hash, r.version, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, r.del_flag
mapper.select: select from preg_report r where r.id = #{id} and r.del_flag = '0'
select from preg_report r where r.actor_user_id = #{actorUserId} and r.request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into preg_report ( name, report_date, checkup_id, note, actor_user_id, request_id, request_hash, version, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{name}, #{reportDate}, #{checkupId}, #{note}, #{actorUserId}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, 1, #{createBy}, now(3) )
mapper.update: update preg_report set name = #{name}, report_date = #{reportDate}, checkup_id = #{checkupId}, note = #{note}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
update preg_report set del_flag = '2', version = version + 1, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
update preg_measurement set report_id = null, update_time = now(3) where report_id = #{reportId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select f.id, f.uploader_user_id, f.original_name, f.storage_key, f.mime_type, f.size_bytes, f.sha256, f.width, f.height, f.state, f.owner_type, f.owner_id, f.sort_order, f.detached_at, f.reclaim_at, f.request_id from preg_file f where f.owner_type = 'REPORT' and f.owner_id = #{reportId} and f.del_flag = '0' order by f.sort_order asc, f.id asc
select from preg_report r where r.report_date = #{date} and r.del_flag = '0' order by r.id asc
